material_request_remaining_cancellation_:
CREATE TABLE material_request_remaining_cancellation_lines (
	cancellation_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_line_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cancelled_qty NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (cancellation_id, request_line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_remaining_cancellation_lines_parent FOREIGN KEY(cancellation_id, request_id, revision_id) REFERENCES material_request_remaining_cancellations (id, request_id, revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_remaining_cancellation_lines_line UNIQUE (request_line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_remaining_cancellation_lines_quantity CHECK (cancelled_qty > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(request_line_id) REFERENCES material_request_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
material_request_remaining_cancellations:
CREATE TABLE material_request_remaining_cancellations (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_person_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_role_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	trace_request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_remaining_cancellations_request UNIQUE (request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_remaining_cancellations_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_remaining_cancellations_trace UNIQUE (actor_user_id, trace_request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_remaining_cancellations_binding UNIQUE (id, request_id, revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_remaining_cancellations_versions CHECK (request_version > 0 AND authorization_version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_remaining_cancellations_hashes CHECK (length(idempotency_key_hash)=64 AND length(request_hash)=64 AND length(evidence_sha256)=64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_remaining_cancellations_reason CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0 AND length(trace_request_id) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_remaining_cancellations_time CHECK (created_at = occurred_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES material_requests (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(revision_id) REFERENCES material_request_revisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_person_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_role_assignment_id) REFERENCES role_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
